definitions.explanation: The act of making something planned or wished for become real or actual.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}を{実現|じつげん}させたい。
examples.english: I want to make my dream come true.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}の{実現|じつげん}に{向|む}けて{努力|どりょく}している。
examples.english: I'm working toward realizing the plan.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{平和|へいわ}の{実現|じつげん}は{難|むずか}しい。

notes:
{実現|じつげん}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to realize" or "to come true."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実現|じつげん}する (to come true, to be realized)
- {実現|じつげん}させる (to make something come true)
- {夢|ゆめ}の{実現|じつげん} (realization of a dream)
- {実現|じつげん}{可能|かのう} (feasible, realizable)
- {実現|じつげん}に{向|む}けて (toward realization)
- {実現|じつげん}{性|せい} (feasibility)

TRANSITIVITY:
- {実現|じつげん}する: intransitive (something realizes/comes true)
- {実現|じつげん}させる: transitive causative (to make something realize)
